name: context-gauge
description: One mod for the prompt cache and context: a band above the prompt with cache time, context and the 5-hour limit, Compact and Last compact buttons; cache-tax (keeps the 1-hour cache warm, guards cold sends) and visible-compact (before/after pane of each compaction) built in.

storage.title: Where compactions are saved
storage.description: temp or home. temp (default): the OS temp folder, cleaned up by the OS (lost on reboot or after a few idle days). home: ~/.claude/visible-compact, kept until you delete it. Any other value is treated as temp.
